game_name: Initial D Arcade Stage Ver. 2 (Japan, Rev A) (GDS-0026A)
general_issues: Select initdv2ja.zip or the merged parent archive initdv2j.zip. Select the exact set in Game Revision; merged archives must contain that revision. Keep naomi2.zip beside the ROM ZIP. Required CHD: gds-0026a.chd. Select CHD Root below the ROM ZIP; disks may be in the set/parent subfolder or directly in that folder.
